name: Historical Carpet Cut Reconciliation
notes: Build053 fixes version-label consistency and adds a guarded Historical Carpet Cut Reconciliation tool. Older Completed cuts are never auto-replayed. Settings can repair only safe candidates where the exact source roll still equals its untouched Original Size; the operator confirms the real Cuts/Pieces count, then the exact Carpet Inventory record, Cutting History, locked operation audit trail and event log are updated together. Build052 exact carpetRecordId linking, Build051 cut-count persistence, Build050 Full Roll Finish, Private Administrator access and Multi-AI Gateway are retained.
